estatico.meta.titulo: ZenTrade | Calm to decide. Disciplined to execute.
estatico.meta.descricao: Rule-based bots, an AI analyst that weighs three scenarios and a risk engine that has the final word. Crypto, Brazil's mini index futures, fixed income and real estate. Open source.
estatico.hero.lead: Rule-based bots, an AI that weighs three scenarios and a risk engine with the final word. For crypto, Brazil's mini index, fixed income and real estate.
estatico.como.titulo: Three layers between the signal and the order.
estatico.como.intro: The rule finds the signal, the AI evaluates it and the risk engine decides. If any layer says no, the order is not sent, and the reason is recorded.
estatico.c1.texto: Strategies built from blocks: breakouts, moving averages, ATR, VWAP, opening range and time windows. Every signal comes with a plain-language explanation.
estatico.c2.texto: Up, sideways and down, each with a probability, a trigger and an invalidation point. The code computes the expected value after fees, and the AI writes the strongest argument against its own proposal.
estatico.c3.texto: It checks daily loss, exposure, frequency and the pause after a loss, sizes the position and places the stop at the exchange itself. The AI can ask for a smaller position, never a bigger one.
estatico.ia.titulo: The AI shows its reasoning and gets a score.
estatico.ia.intro: Every Claude decision is graded afterwards. When it approved, did the trade make money? When it vetoed, would the trade have lost?
estatico.ia.l1: Three scenarios with probabilities that add up to 100%, checked by the code.
estatico.ia.l2: Mandatory counterargument: the AI names the biggest weakness of its own idea.
estatico.ia.l3: Full context: real fees, ATR, 1h and 4h trend, session hours, event calendar and its own track record.
estatico.ia.l4: Protection against manipulation: text from the internet comes in as data, never as an instruction.
estatico.cen.titulo: How the AI weighs a signal
estatico.cen.nota: Illustrative example. Real rule: it only trades with a positive expected value after fees and a favorable scenario of at least 60%.
estatico.bt.titulo: Every strategy goes through tests designed to break it.
estatico.bt.intro: Before any real money is used, the strategy faces real costs and data it has never seen. If it only works on the past, ZenTrade tells you.
estatico.bt.l1: Real costs: fees, slippage and spread; on the mini index, B3 fees and ticks.
estatico.bt.l2: Worst case inside the candle: if the stop and the target fit in the same candle, the stop counts.
estatico.bt.l3: Out of sample and walk-forward: evaluation on data the strategy has never seen.
estatico.bt.l4: Monte Carlo and deflated Sharpe: separates skill from luck, counting every attempt.
estatico.bt.l5: Pre-registered research: the plan is written before the result and published even when it fails.
estatico.ver.sub: Donchian 20/10 with a trend filter, 15 coins, 4-hour candles, 2021 to 2026, entry at the next open.
estatico.ver.v1: Profit on 13 of 15 coins, Sharpe 1.47, max drawdown 3.9%
estatico.ver.v2s: The edge may be shrinking and stays under watch.
estatico.ver.v3: Buy and hold made more over the period
estatico.ver.v3s: With 70% to 90% drawdowns along the way. The report shows both sides.
estatico.win.titulo: The mini index, trade by trade.
estatico.win.intro: ZenTrade reads the official B3 files with every trade of the session and builds its own candles. Just drag the files onto the screen. With your broker's MetaTrader 5, it fetches years of history and updates every day.
estatico.win.l1: The right contract every day, with the expiry rollover done automatically.
estatico.win.l2: Session rules: entry hours, opening auction and closing positions before the session ends.
estatico.win.l3: Event calendar: central bank meetings, inflation and US data can pause or scale down the bot.
estatico.win.l4: Long and short trades, contracts sized by risk in reais and estimated day trade tax.
estatico.win.nota: Real B3 data, October 14 to 19, 2026, imported by ZenTrade.
estatico.pat.titulo: From bitcoin to your apartment, on one screen.
estatico.pat.intro: ZenTrade puts everything together in reais with up-to-date exchange rates, and the assistant answers about any part of it.
estatico.pat.c1p: Balance per coin straight from the exchange, gross and net of fees.
estatico.pat.c2p: CDB, Treasury, LCI, LCA and savings through Open Finance, with official CDI and IPCA.
estatico.pat.c3p: Property, short-term rental, flip, land, REITs, crowdfunding and consortium, with a simulator.
estatico.ass.l1: Use your own Claude account or an API key.
estatico.ass.l2: A knowledge base per person, searchable by keyword or by meaning.
estatico.ass.l3: A spending cap on AI per day and per month.
estatico.seg.c1t: The stop lives at the exchange
estatico.seg.c1p: The protective stop lives on Binance itself. If your computer shuts down, the stop stays active.
estatico.seg.c2p: One button blocks new entries for every bot at once, without cancelling protective stops.
estatico.seg.c3p: Encrypted exchange keys, keys with withdrawal permission refused, two-factor authentication and re-authentication for real money.
estatico.seg.c4p: Daily loss, exposure, frequency and a pause after a losing streak, per bot and for the whole account.
estatico.seg.c5p: Every signal, proposal, veto and order is recorded with its reason.
estatico.seg.c6p: Runs on your machine with Docker. Open source (AGPL-3.0), data separated per person and privacy built in from day one.
estatico.int.l1: orders, wallet, stop at the exchange, testnet and paper trading
estatico.int.l2: official files and years of mini index history
estatico.int.l3: Anthropic API or your own Claude Code account
estatico.int.l4: Open Finance, official CDI, Selic and IPCA
estatico.int.l6: fast price series and search by meaning
estatico.faq.a1: No. Nobody can guarantee profit. ZenTrade offers a method: strategies tested with real costs, decisions explained and measured, and a risk engine that limits each day's losses.
estatico.faq.q2: Do I have to pay for the AI?
estatico.faq.a2: You can use your own Claude account or an API key, with a spending cap. The bots also work with only the rules and the risk engine.
estatico.faq.q3: Does it trade with real money?
estatico.faq.a3: Only when you turn it on, with two-factor authentication and re-authentication. Before that there are three practice modes: observe, paper (real prices with simulated orders) and the exchange testnet.
estatico.faq.a4: On your machine or your server, with Docker. Your data and your keys stay with you.
estatico.faq.a5: Yes, under the AGPL-3.0 license. You can read, audit and improve the code.
estatico.fim.intro: Run ZenTrade with Docker, connect your exchange in practice mode and watch the bots work before you risk any money.
